source: 561 Language of the Stars
target: 561 Lingua Stellarum

source: 561 Language of the Stars
target: 561 Lingua Stellarum

source: Lato Guiaro struggled to keep silent, but the words burst out of him.
target: Lato Guiaro silentium tenere conabatur, sed verba e eo erupta sunt.

source: After a long internal battle, he finally responded, “He’s the most powerful among us.
target: Post longam internam pugnam, tandem respondit: “Inter nos potentissimus est.

source: Before joining the Fisheries Guild committee, he served as a deputy host on the sea sacrifice ship a whopping 11 times.
target: Antequam in commissionem Gildis Piscariorum se iunxit, decies undecim vice ut vice hospitis in nave sacrificii marini functus est.

source: He gained numerous boons and established a solid connection with the sea.
target: Multa beneficia adeptus est et nexum solidum cum mari constituit.

source: “He can fly.
target: “Volare potest.

source: If he’s not afraid of losing lifespan, he can temporarily take control of these waters on behalf of the Governor of the Sea.
target: Si non timet vitam amittere, his aquis pro gubernatore maris ad tempus imperium suscipere potest.

source: He possesses other special abilities, though they’re rarely revealed.
target: Alias facultates speciales habet, sed raro revelantur.

source: We’re not entirely sure either.
target: Nos etiam non plene certi sumus.

source: What we do know is that the failure of last year’s sea prayer ritual significantly weakened him.”
target: Quod scimus, defectus ritus orationis maris anni superioris eum maxime debilitavit.”

source: Lato paused and couldn’t resist adding, “First and foremost, we are astronomers.
target: Lato pausavit et non potuit impedire se addere: “Primum et ante omnia, astronomi sumus.

source: Our expertise lies in observing the stars’ transformations and calculating their patterns.
target: Peritia nostra consistit in observatione transformationum stellarum et in figuris eorum computandis.

source: Keep in mind that the annual sea prayer ritual doesn’t have a fixed date.
target: Memento ritus orationis maris annui diem fixum non habere.

source: It could happen any day during the first week of November.
target: Hoc fieri potest quovis die intra primam hebdomadinem Novembri.

source: This is because, to enter that special area that communicates with the sea, the stars need to be in specific positions to open the corresponding passageway.
target: Hoc enim est, quod ad ingressum in illam regionem specialem, quae cum mari communicat, stellae in certis locis esse debent ad viam correspondens aperiendum.

source: “The date of a similar phenomenon varies from year to year.
target: “Dies huiusmodi rei ex anno in annum variat.

source: Astronomers with sufficient knowledge must predict it in advance through observation and calculation.”
target: Astronomi satis periti eam per observationem et computationem praevidere debent.”

source: The idea of Fisheries Guild committee members being astronomers seems comical and absurd…
target: Idea membrorum commissionis Gildis Piscariorum astronomos esse ridicula et absurda videtur…

source: Lumian didn’t interrupt Lato Guiaro’s narrative.
target: Lumian narrationem Lato Guiaro non interpellavit.

source: The self-proclaimed astronomer continued his explanation.
target: Astronomus, se ipse proclamans, explicationem suam continuavit.

source: “Secondly, we are humans who worship the sea and the cosmos.
target: “Secundo, homines sumus qui mare et caelum colunt.

source: We can receive revelations and guidance of fate from the changes in tides, the waves of the sea, and the trajectories of the stars, avoiding danger and making the right choices.
target: Revelationes et consilia fati ex mutationibus aestuum, fluctuum maris, et trajectoriarum stellarum accipere possumus, periculum vitantes atque recte decernentes.

source: Many times, we refer to such revelations and guidance as the Language of the Stars.”
target: Saepe tales revelationes et monitiones Lingua Stellarum appellamus.”

source: The Language of the Stars… sounds pretty dangerous.
target: Lingua Stellarum… satis periculosa videtur.

source: How do you know it’s not something risky like Termiboros or Ludwig winking at you?
target: Quomodo scis non esse rem periculosam, ut Termiboros aut Ludwig, qui tibi oculos intermittenter conludet?

source: Lumian resisted the urge to shake his head and sighed inwardly.
target: Lumian impetum caput concutiendi repulit et intime suspiravit.

source: “Furthermore, we are descendants of the sea and the cosmos, serving as clergymen who offer sacrifices to them.
target: “Praeterea, progenies maris et caeli sumus, sacerdotes qui eis sacrificia celebrant.

source: We can manipulate the power of the land to completely immobilize the target or make them float.
target: Potestatem terrae regere possumus ut obiectum omnino immobilis fiat aut levetur.

source: We can emit rays from the cosmos, causing damage to the enemy’s body structure and weakening them.
target: Radios ex caelo emitti possumus, qui structuras hostium laedunt et eos debilitant.

source: Without the corresponding superpowers to treat them, they will face an irreversible and agonizing death.
target: Sine viribus supernis necessariis ad eos curandos, mortem irreversibilem et agonizantem patiuntur.

source: We can also create a powerful magnetic effect.
target: Etiam validum effectum magneticum efficere possumus.

source: Combined with the power of the land, we can generate a half-real illusion.
target: Coniuncta cum potestate terrae, illusionem semiveram creari possumus.

source: We call it the Cosmic Void.”
target: Illud vocamus Vacuitatem Cosmicanam.”

source: Lato’s expression gradually turned fanatical.
target: Vultus Lato paulatim in fanaticum mutatus est.

source: From a mysticism perspective, the Beyonder characteristics of the Children of the Sea involve the land and the cosmos.
target: Ex prospectu mystico, proprietates extraordinariae Filiorum Maris terram et caelum amplectuntur.

source: According to Aurore’s knowledge, it encompasses gravity, radiation, and electromagnetism.
target: Secundum scientiam Aurore, id comprehendit gravitatem, radationem, et electromagnetismum.

source: Furthermore, due to gravity and electromagnetism, they also possess some illusionary and spatial abilities.
target: Praeterea, propter gravitatem et electromagnetismum, quoque quasdam facultates illusionarias et spatiales habent.

source: Lumian, rephrasing Lato Guiaro’s words for easier comprehension, couldn’t help but criticize inwardly, “Hey, you’re the Children of the Sea, not the Children of the Stars.
target: Lumian, verba Lato Guiaro ad facilius intellegendum redimens, intus reprehendere non potuit: “Heus, filii Maris estis, non filii Stellarum!

source: Why don’t I see many sea-related powers…
target: Cur non multas potentias maritimas video…

source: Lato took a deep breath and continued, “We are also the navigators of the sea and the cosmos.
target: Lato altum spiritum cepit et perrexit dicens: “Etiam nos sumus nautae maris et caeli.

source: We can find the right path under any circumstances, guided by the performance of the sea and the stars.
target: Viam rectam invenire possumus in omnibus condicionibus, ducti signis maris et stellarum.

source: We can use this power to help others.”
target: Hanc vim ad alios adiuvandos uti possumus.”

source: “Without our guidance, ships can’t enter that special water even on the correct date.
target: “Sine nostro ductu, naves illas aquas speciales, etiam in die expedito, ingredi non possunt.

source: That’s why Nolfi insisted on returning to Port Santa before setting off.
target: Ideo Nolfi in Portum Santa redire instavit priusquam proficisceretur.

source: Although she knew the coordinates and route of the sea sacrificial land from her mother, she would never have reached it if she didn’t set off from Port Santa.
target: Quamquam notitia habebat de coordinatis et itinere terrae sacrificii maris a matre sua, eam numquam attingeret, nisi proficisceretur ex Portu Santa.

source: The spawn that come to land from the seabed also rely on our abilities in this area to survive the fog, vortex, and storms without losing their way in the sea route or being swallowed by darkness.
target: Proles, quae ex fundo maris in terram veniunt, etiam in nostris facultatibus confidunt, ut nebula, vorago, et tempestates superent, iter maris non amittendo nec a tenebris devorentur.

source: Navigators… Lumian suddenly recalled the strange fish he had encountered on the Flying Bird, the Mutated Bannerfish, who could control the waves.
target: Navigatores… Lumian subito recordatus est piscium insolitorum quos in "Flying Bird" invenerat, Bannerfish Mutata, qui fluctus regere poterant.

source: They were also known as Death Navigators!
target: Illi etiam Navigatores Mortis vocati erant!

source: “Have you heard of the strange fish known as Death Navigators?”
target: “Audivistine de piscibus insolitis, qui Navigatores Mortis vocantur?”

source: Lumian interrupted Lato Guiaro’s account.
target: Lumian narrationem Lato Guiaro interpellavit.

source: Lato hesitated for a moment before responding,
target: Lato paulisper vacillavit antequam respondit,

source: “Yes, they’re also spawn of the sea.
target: “Ita, etiam proles maris sunt.

source: We all suspect that they were transformed from the Governors of the Sea who returned to the sea.”
target: Omnes suspicamus eos ex Gubernatoribus Maris, qui ad mare redierunt, transformatos esse.”

source: Transformed from the Governors of the Sea?
target: Transformatos ex Gubernatoribus Maris?

source: Lumian raised his eyebrows.
target: Lumian supercilia erexit.

source: Lato swallowed and explained, “They should still be fused with the sea, so future generations will be born, but their strength is inferior to theirs.
target: Lato deglutivit et explicavit: “Adhuc cum mari coniungi debent, ut generationes futuras oriantur, sed eorum potentia minus quam eorum est.

source: In the past, they only roamed those waters.
target: In praeterito, solum in illis aquis vagabantur.

source: In recent years, for some reason, they occasionally swam out and returned.
target: In annis recentioribus, quaedam causa, aliquoties extra e aquas exsiluere et redierunt.

source: After the sea prayer ritual failed last year, this situation became even more frequent.
target: Post defectum ritus orationis maris anni superioris, haec condicio etiam frequentior facta est.

source: Did the failure of the ritual cause the Death Navigators to go out more frequently?
target: Num defectus ritus Mortis Navigatores frequentius exire causa fuit?

source: Did the Death Navigators lure sailors to those special waters?
target: Num Mortis Navigatores nautas ad illas aquas speciales alliciebant?

source: Were they ultimately devoured by the sea?
target: Num tandem a mari devorati sunt?

source: Lumian’s mind raced with questions, but he knew that Lato Guiaro couldn’t answer them.
target: Mens Lumiani plurimas quaestiones affluebatur, sed sciebat Lato Guiaro eas respondere non posse.

source: Lato returned to the main topic.
target: Lato ad rem principalem rediit.

source: We can still manipulate the waves to a certain extent and influence the tides, but we can’t compare to Juan Oro, much less the Governor of the Sea.
target: Fluctus ad certum modum regere et aestus mores afficere possumus, sed nos cum Juan Oro, nedum gubernatore maris, comparari non possumus.

source: That’s more like a Child of the Sea? That’s why they think it’s easier to bury me in the sea?
target: Nonne hoc magis convenit ut Filius Maris? Idcirco putant me in mari facilius sepeliri?

source: Lumian pondered as he inquired about a few more details. He then lowered his right foot from his left knee and slowly stood up.
target: Lumian meditabatur dum plura percontabatur. Dein dextrum pedem a sinistro genu abstulit et lente surrexit.

source: Nodding at the Knight of Swords in Lato’s eyes, Lumian said to Lato Guiaro, “Last request, release Nolfi and Batna.”
target: Noddans ad Equum Gladii, qui in oculis Lato appareret, Lumian Lato Guiaro dixit: “Ultimam petitionem: libera Nolfi et Batna.”

source: With that, Lumian walked to the bedroom window.
target: Hoc facto, Lumian ad fenestram cubiculi ambulavit.

source: Simultaneously, the Knight of Swords, who had possessed Lato Guiaro, vanished.
target: Simul, Eques Gladii, qui Lato Guiaro possidebat, evanuit.

source: The committee member of the Fisheries Guild regained control of his body.
target: Membrum commissionis Gildis Piscariorum iterum dominatum sui corporis obtinuit.

source: As Lumian left, Lato Guiaro couldn’t help but express his confusion, fear, and a hint of uncontrollable emotion, “I thought you’d kill me once you got the information…”
target: Dum Lumian discedebat, Lato Guiaro confusionem, timorem, et parvam passionis indomitabiles exprimere non potuit, dicens: “Putabam te me interficere, simulquam informationem adeptus esses…”

source: Otherwise, wouldn’t it expose the fact that you have many hidden helpers, the secret of a faction behind you, and the uniqueness of your helpers?
target: Alioquin nonne patefieret quod multos adiutores occulte haberes, secretum factionis tibi adsistentis, atque singularem virtutem auxiliatorum tuorum?

source: Lumian didn’t look back and continued forward.
target: Lumian non retrospexit et procedebat.

source: On the way, he pressed down on his golden straw hat and smiled.
target: In itinere, pileum stramineum aureum premebat et subridens ridebat.

source: “To you, this might be important, but not to me.”
target: “Tibi hoc fortasse grave sit, sed mihi non.”

source: Just as Lato Guiaro was about to say something, he saw the body of the adventurer, Louis Berry, suddenly turn black and thin, transforming into a shadow that disappeared from the crimson moonlight’s reach.
target: Ita ut Lato Guiaro aliquid dicere parabat, vidit corpus viatoris Ludovici Berry subito in nigrum et tenue mutari, convertens in umbram quae lumine lunaris coccinei evanuit.

source: After staring at the darkness for a while, Lato adjusted the collar of his robe and left the master bedroom.
target: Postquam aliquantisper in obscuritate aspexit, Lato scapulam vestis suae temperavit et ex cubiculo principali discessit.

source: He personally headed to the basement to release Nolfi and Batna.
target: Ipse ad cellam subterraneam properavit ad Nolfi et Batna liberandos.

source: Opposite the building where his family resided, beneath a row of verdant trees,
target: Contra aedificium, in quo familia eius habitabat, sub serie arborum viridium,

source: Lumian leaned leisurely against the black gas streetlamp pole, gazing at the glass windows illuminated by the light.
target: Lumian tranquille ad columnam lucernae nigrae recubuit, spectans fenestras vitreas, quae lumine illustratae erant.

source: The disheveled, pale-faced Knight of Swords materialized behind him and asked in a deep voice, “Are you really not going to kill him?”
target: Eques Gladii, facie soluta pallide, post eum apparuit et voce profunda rogavit: “Num vere eum non interficies?”

source: Lumian chuckled and said, “If we kill him, who’s going to inform Juan Oro that I have powerful helpers and the support of a powerful faction lurking in the shadows?”
target: Lumian risit et dixit: “Si eum interficimus, quis Juan Oro certiorem faciet me potentes adiutores et sustentationem factionis robustae in umbris latentis habere?”

source: He couldn’t just toss tarot cards at Lato Guiaro’s corpse, could he?
target: Nonne non potuit simpliciter chartas taroci in corpus Lato Guiaro conicere?

source: Furthermore, the problem lay in the fact that no one knew that the adventurer, Louis Berry, was a Minor Arcana cardholder of the Tarot Club.
target: Praeterea, quaestio erat quod nemo sciebat viatorem Ludovicum Berry chartas Minoris Arcanae in Taroci Club tenere.

source: Upon hearing Lumian’s response, the Knight of Swords pondered for a moment before vanishing into the darkness.
target: Audito responsu Lumiani, Eques Gladii per momentum meditatus est, antequam in tenebras evanuerit.

source: Before long, Batna emerged from the house where Lato Guiaro’s extended family resided, clutching his rapier and revolver.
target: Non multo post, Batna ex domo, ubi familia Lato Guiaro habitabat, emergit, rapier et revolver tenens.

source: Upon seeing Lumian, they looked a little ashamed and approached him with slow steps.
target: Videns Lumian, parum verecundi videbantur et lente accesserunt ad eum.

source: “Thank you for saving us,” Nolfi, adorable in a blouse and brown pants, expressed her sincere gratitude.
target: “Gratias tibi ago quod nos servavisti,” inquit Nolfi, amabilis in pallio et braccis fuscis, sincera gratiam exprimens.

source: Batna said, “I’m well aware of Nolfi’s intentions and haven’t been deceived by her. I sympathize with the tragic fate of these sea spawn and hope to help her end all of this.”
target: Batna dixit, “Certe consilia Nolfi mihi nota sunt nec ab ea deceptus sum. Misericordia afficio fatum tragicum huius prole maris et spero me ei subvenire ut totum hoc finiat.”

source: Lumian looked at Nolfi.
target: Lumian Nolfi spectavit.

source: “What kind of tragic end will it lead to?”
target: “Quo genere fatale exitum hoc adducet?”

source: The committee members of the Fisheries Guild seemed quite pleased.
target: Membra commissionis Gildis Piscariorum satis laeta videbantur.

source: Nolfi fell silent for a moment before saying, “All Maidens of the Sea and Children of the Sea eventually transform into a lizard-like humanoid monster.
target: Nolfi paulisper siluit, antequam dixit: “Omnes puellae maris et filii maris tandem in monstrum humanoidem, simile lacertae, se transformant.

source: Perhaps earlier, perhaps later, my mother passed away because she was attacked by assassins hired by the Fisheries Guild and wanted to die as a human.
target: Fortasse prius, fortasse postea, mater mea perivit, quia a sicariis a Gildis Piscariorum conductis oppressa est et mori ut homo cupiebat.

source: Not only did she refuse treatment, but she also inflicted some damage on herself.”
target: Non solum curationem recusavit, sed etiam sibi ipsi damna attulit.”

source: In that case, the humanoid lizard at Rubió Paco’s house is a common sight in families around Port Santa.
target: Ergo, lacertae humanoides in domo Rubió Paco visae sunt vulgo inter familias circa Portum Santa.

source: Why the need for secrecy?
target: Cur igitur hoc secreto servari debet?

source: Lumian turned to Batna with a smile, asking, “Did you know Nolfi would transform into a humanoid lizard?”
target: Lumian ad Batna, cum subridente se vertens, rogavit: “Scisne Nolfi in lacertam humanoidam se transformaturam esse?”

source: “Yes.” Batna expressed that he didn’t mind.
target: “Ita,” respondit Batna, nihil sibi molestum esse.

source: At that moment, Nolfi inquired, “Then do you know what a humanoid lizard looks like?”
target: Illo momento, Nolfi interrogavit: “Scisne quo modo lacerta humana videatur?”

source: As she spoke, the rather attractive female adventurer’s eyes widened. Shimmering illusory scales appeared on her body, and her skin transformed into that of a snake.
target: Dum loquebatur, oculi illae adventurae feminae decori dilatati sunt; squamae illusoriae nitidae in ea apparuerunt, et cutis eius in serpentis similitudinem mutata est.

source: Batna jumped in fright, taking a step back involuntarily.
target: Batna timore exsiliavit, et inopinato gradus retrorsum fecit.

source: Lumian continued to ask Nolfi, “Why didn’t you rent a boat at a nearby port and find a sailor to sail it over? Why choose a ship rental company in Port Santa?”
target: Lumian perrexit interrogans Nolfi: “Cur navem in porto proximo non locastisti atque nautae consilium inquirendi causa eam transvecturam optasti? Cur societatem navium locationis in Portu Santa eligis?”

source: Nolfi undid the phantom scales, reverting to her original appearance, frustration and embarrassment evident in her voice.
target: Nolfi scalas phantasmatum dissolvit, ad formam pristinam revertens, cum ira et verecundia in voce manifeste exprimentibus.

source: “In Port Santa, people often rent boats for fishing and sightseeing. This should be a very ordinary thing…”
target: “In Portu Santa, homines saepe naves locant ad piscandum et ad visitandum. Hoc res prorsus ordinaris esse debet…”

source: Lumian sighed helplessly.
target: Lumian infelix suspiravit.

source: “Did you know that last year’s sea prayer ritual failed?
target: “Scisne ritum orationis maris anni superioris defecisse?

source: The Fisheries Guild will be on high alert this year, investigating all unstable factors.
target: Gilda Piscariorum hoc anno vigilantia summa erunt, omnes incertas condiciones investigantes.

source: Besides, the sea prayer ritual is only a few days away.
target: Praeterea, ritus orationis maris in paucis diebus appropinquat.

source: It’s inevitable to start paying attention to those who rent boats to go out to sea.”
target: Inevitabile est incipere observare eos, qui naves locant ad mare proficiscendum.”

source: Nolfi and Batna remained silent, resembling two students.
target: Nolfi et Batna silentes mansuerunt, instar duorum discipulorum.

source: After a moment, Nolfi asked in surprise and suspicion, “Did the sea prayer ritual fail last year?”
target: Post aliquod tempus, Nolfi, stupore et suspicione affecta, interrogavit: “Defecitne ritus orationis maris anni superioris?”

source: Lumian didn’t answer immediately.
target: Lumian statim non respondit.

source: He thought for a moment and said,
target: Post paulum cogitavit et dixit,

source: “You want to end the sea prayer ritual with just the two of you? What gave you the confidence?”
target: “Vultisne totum ritum orationis maris solum inter vos duos finire? Quid vobis fiduciam dedit?”

source: Nolfi pursed her lips and stated, “As long as I can enter those waters and find the palace, I have a way to destroy it and end everything.”
target: Nolfi labra contraxit et dixit: “Dummodo in eas aquas ingredi possim et palatium inveniam, viam habeo id delere et omnia finire.”

source: “Palace?” Lumian’s eyebrows twitched.
target: “Palatium?” Lumian supercilia subito contraxit.

source: Nolfi nodded.
target: Nolfi annuit.

source: “When my mother was possessed by the sea, she saw a strange palace through her spirituality and the connection between them. It’s located at the bottom of the sea. It’s the palace of the sea!”
target: “Cum mater mea ab mari possessa esset, palatium insolitum per eius spiritualem connectionem vidit. Illud in imo mari situm est. Id est palatium maris!”
